scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp metadata.json stylesheet.css dist/ && mkdir -p dist/schemas && cp schemas/*.gschema.xml dist/schemas/ && glib-compile-schemas --strict dist/schemas
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../g-os-dock@cgreg21.github.io.zip .
scripts.install: npm run pack && gnome-extensions install --force g-os-dock@cgreg21.github.io.zip
